INVALID_ARGUMENTS.message: Arguments do not match the tool schema.

INVALID_TARGET.message: The selected target or source is not valid for this operation.

UNSUPPORTED.message: This target does not support the requested operation.

UNSUPPORTED_ACTION.message: The element does not support this semantic action.

UNSUPPORTED_SIGNAL.message: This target does not support the requested process signal.

DISABLED.message: Automation is disabled or paused on the target.

PERMISSION_DENIED.message: The target has not authorized this operation.

GRANT_EXPIRED.message: The original authorization is no longer valid.

APPROVAL_PENDING.message: A permission request is awaiting the target user's decision.

BUSY.message: The target has reached an operation or queue limit.

APP_NOT_READY.message: The target application is not ready to handle this operation.

TARGET_DISCONNECTED.message: The target disconnected before a result was received.

CHANNEL_NOT_OPEN.message: The automation channel is not open.

OPEN_TIMEOUT.message: The automation channel did not open before its deadline.

ASSEMBLY_TIMEOUT.message: A complete response was not received before its deadline.

SESSION_CLOSED.message: The original automation session has ended.

TIMEOUT.message: The operation did not return a result before its deadline.

STALE_ELEMENT.message: The element reference expired or was invalidated; obtain a fresh observation.

ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND.message: The referenced element is no longer available.

ELEMENT_DISABLED.message: The selected element is currently disabled.

PROTECTED_ELEMENT.message: Protected controls cannot be inspected or operated.

WINDOW_FOCUS_LOST.message: The bound window lost focus; the input may already have taken effect.

WINDOW_NOT_FOUND.message: The selected window is no longer available.

GEOMETRY_CHANGED.message: Display or window geometry changed; refresh coordinates before continuing.

INPUT_INTERRUPTED.message: The input operation was interrupted and may be partially applied.

INPUT_TIMEOUT.message: Input execution exceeded its deadline and may be partially applied.

CONTROL_REQUIRED.message: An active control lease is required. Call control.acquire with a monitor sourceId from screen.sources to prepare sharing and control together, or trackId for a live native monitor stream.

CAPTURE_REQUIRED.message: A live native monitor capture is required. Choose kind=monitor from screen.sources and call control.acquire with its sourceId to prepare sharing and control together.

RESOURCE_CLOSED.message: The referenced stream has ended or is no longer available. Refresh sessions.list for live track IDs, or screen.sources to choose a new capture source.

RESULT_TOO_LARGE.message: The result exceeds the transport limit; request a smaller region or page.

JOB_NOT_FOUND.message: The job is unavailable to this caller and its original authorization.

STDIN_CLOSED.message: The job's standard input has already closed.

CANCELLED.message: The operation was cancelled; cancellation does not undo effects already applied.

DUPLICATE_REQUEST.message: A request with this identifier is already being handled.

EXECUTION_FAILED.message: The operation failed; inspect the target before repeating a state-changing action.
